column3: With respect to the Soudry NYC Multifamily Portfolio Mortgage Loan (7.7%), a condominium declaration is recorded against title to the 2848 Brighton 7th Street Mortgaged Property (0.4%), however, according to the borrower sponsor, the condominium is no longer in effect. We cannot assure you that the condominium is not currently in legal existence, will not be re-constituted in the future or that such Mortgaged Property will not be subject to any condominium assessments, limitations or restrictions contained in such declaration.
